title: 2 倒计时02
content_zh:
昨晚翻了一小时资料，对游决这个老同学的能力很满意，感慨老天待她不薄，真是雪中送炭。
同窗两年，虽然话说得不多，但她和游决的名字也在成绩单的前排挨了整整两年。
不认识就算了，她硬着头皮让前台再给他打电话，说她是来咨询案子的。
结果电话那头传来一句掷地有声的“没空”，冷漠地连前台都不知道怎么圆场。
打量倪夏的眼神也变得复杂，仿佛认定她是专程跑来攀关系打算白\嫖的。
就算是不想出钱的投资商，也不曾这样把闭门羹毫不留情地泼到倪夏脸上过。
投资商无故违约，资金来源没了苗头，现在连找个律师都能搞得她颜面扫地。
坐电梯下到了地库，倪夏面色通红走出电梯厅，看着左右两边一模一样的玻璃门，更是气得呼吸不顺。
来的时候太着急，她根本就没记录自己停车的位置，只隐约记得黄色的墙漆。
凭着记忆在这偌大的停车场找车也不现实，倪夏只能掏出手机找定位。
倪夏原本没在意，但当来人的身影进入她的余光时，注意力莫名被牵引。
她还没明白自己为什么要抬头，就见铮亮的电梯厅里，一个西装革履的男人阔步而来——
宽肩长腿，步子迈得大而稳，即便低头看着手机，其身形体态也具有十足的吸引力。
许是倪夏的目光太过直白，男人也有所察觉，在距离倪夏两三米远时抬起了眼。
相比倪夏的错愕，游决只是瞥了她一眼，随即继续大步不停地往前走。
但眼下的正经事是官司，她也没心思琢磨别的，硬着头皮说道：“我是倪夏，咱们高中一个班的，你真不记得我啦？”
忍了忍，才僵硬地笑着说：“我最近想打一个官司，正好听我表妹说你很厉害，所以——”
手机铃声不适时地响起，游决竖掌比了个暂停的动作，随即背过身接电话。
大老远跑这么一趟，好不容易碰着游决了，话却没说完又被打断，倪夏憋屈得抱着双臂用力呼吸了好几口。
content_en:
I spent an hour looking through the information last night and was very satisfied with the ability of this old classmate You Jue. I felt that God had treated her well, and it was a timely help.
They were classmates for two years. Although they didn't talk much, her and You Jue's names were in the front row of the report card for two full years.
Even if he didn't know him, she forced the front desk to call him again, saying that she was here to consult on the case.
As a result, a resounding "No time" came from the other end of the phone, and the front desk was so cold that even the front desk didn't know how to smooth things over.
The look in Ni Xia's eyes became complicated, as if he believed that she had come here specifically to establish a relationship and to have sex for free.
Even investors who didn't want to pay had never thrown the rejection in Ni Xia's face so mercilessly.
The investor defaulted on the contract without any reason, and the source of funds has disappeared. Now even finding a lawyer can make her lose face.
After taking the elevator down to the basement, Ni Xia walked out of the elevator hall with a red face. Looking at the identical glass doors on the left and right, she was so angry that she couldn't breathe smoothly.
She was in such a hurry when she arrived that she didn't record where she parked her car. She only vaguely remembered the yellow wall paint.
It was unrealistic to find a car in this huge parking lot based on memory, so Ni Xia could only take out her mobile phone to find the location.
Ni Xia didn't pay attention at first, but when the figure of the visitor entered her peripheral vision, her attention was inexplicably drawn.
Before she understood why she had to look up, she saw a man in a suit and leather shoes striding towards him in the bright elevator hall——
With broad shoulders and long legs, and a long and steady step, his figure is still very attractive even when he is looking down at his mobile phone.
Perhaps Ni Xia's gaze was too direct, and the man noticed it, and raised his eyes when he was two or three meters away from Ni Xia.
Compared to Ni Xia's shock, You Jue just glanced at her and then continued to stride forward.
But the serious matter at the moment is the lawsuit, and she has no time to think about anything else. She bites the bullet and says, "I am Ni Xia. We are in the same class in high school. Do you really not remember me?"
After enduring it, he smiled stiffly and said, "I recently wanted to file a lawsuit, and I happened to hear my cousin say that you are very powerful, so——"
The cell phone rang untimely. You Jue raised his hands to indicate a pause, then turned his back to answer the phone.
After traveling all this way, he finally bumped into You Jue, but he was interrupted again before he could finish his words. Ni Xia was so aggrieved that she folded her arms and took several deep breaths.
